coverage.text: S2 compressions_active audio track only detected three brief acoustic artifacts (271.1-273.2s, 366.9-371.2s during cheering, and 432.7-435.7s during applause) because manual compressions on the simulation mannequin produced minimal acoustic thump and S1 optical flow was absent. Visual inspection shows continuous manual chest compressions from 81.0s to 229.0s and from 235.5s to 365.5s, bounding one true compression interruption (229.0-235.5s) and permanent cessation for ROSC at 365.5s.

All 13 device_audio candidates (defib_charge_aborted and defibrillation_shock) are false positives triggered by periodic patient monitor alarm chimes and room acoustics. The patient remained in non-shockable PEA prior to ROSC, and no provider ever operated or charged the defibrillator.

0.0-455.8s: Simulation environment where airway placement/bagging and medication administration are partially mimed and verbalized per facilitator instructions at 0.0-13.0s. Monitor screens on the left cart and wall are too small/low-contrast for direct waveform OCR.
